result.question: Before we run any trend model on Transformer 1 at MAIN, check how complete the acetylene and co records are between 2024-01-15T00:00:00.000000 and 2024-01-19T00:00:00.000000. For each gas, report the non-null count, the first and last timestamps with data, and any day in the window with no sample. Give each channel a verdict of 'usable' only if it has at least 4 non-null samples. If a channel fails, check whether hydrogen has at least 4 samples in the same window and could be used instead.
result.answer:
Both acetylene and co are complete for Transformer 1 at MAIN between 2024-01-15 and 2024-01-19 (end not included), so both are usable. The window has 4 days: Jan 15, 16, 17 and 18.

| Gas | Non-null count | First timestamp | Last timestamp | Days with no sample | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| acetylene | 4 | 2024-01-15T00:00:00 | 2024-01-18T00:00:00 | None | usable |
| co | 4 | 2024-01-15T00:00:00 | 2024-01-18T00:00:00 | None | usable |

Each gas has one sample per day at midnight, which is exactly the 4-sample minimum. One more missing sample in this window would make a channel fail.

Since neither channel failed, hydrogen isn't needed as a backup. It also has 4 samples in the same window, one per day, if you want it later.
